description: Periodic and annualized IRR of periodic cash flows, as decimals (0.085 = 8.5%), solved deterministically by scanning a 1-point grid of per-period rates and bisecting each sign change; reports every root it finds when cash flows have multiple IRRs (two roots within one grid step can be missed). Errors when the flows do not change sign or no root lies between -99.99% and 1000% per period. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.irr@2 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

cash_flows.description: Periodic cash flows at t = 0, 1, 2, …; negative for outflows (e.g. purchase price at t = 0). At most 1200.

periods_per_year.description: Cash-flow periods per year, used only to annualize the result: 1 for annual flows, 4 for quarterly, 12 for monthly.

name: calc_irr
title: Internal rate of return
